data_policy: public train only; development reuse; no Task2 session4 or Task3 seed42 final evaluation; held-out labels used only for final metrics

protocol_deviations.preregistered: group the held session's 10992 trials into 2748 rows by sample using only group_ptr/trial_sample_indices and average raw counts per sample
protocol_deviations.observed: every cached train block stores one trial per sample (group_ptr diffs are all 1, n_samples = n_trials = 10992), so the prescribed grouping cannot produce 2748 rows and cannot give the frozen one-row-per-class column target of 1.0 without using held-out labels
protocol_deviations.implemented: kept the label-free 10992 unlabeled trial rows and used the structurally implied balanced column target rows/n_classes = 4.0; final evaluation still uses experiment 48's official four-repeat mean rows

protocol_deviations.preregistered: 50ms bins over the 250ms window (preregistration loader bin_ms=50)
protocol_deviations.observed: 50ms counting gives 134 x 5 = 670 (mice1) and 78 x 5 = 390 (mice2); the 1340/780 widths belong to the 25ms view
protocol_deviations.implemented: kept the frozen bin_ms=50 loader; no view change
